discoveries: MOM blocks `normalcdf`, `invnormalcdf`, `tcdf`, `invtcdf`, etc. unless the CC begins with `loadlibrary("stats")`. Documented in `questions/sampling-distributions/AGENTS.md`.
The 4-arg form `normalcdf(mean, sd, lower, upper)` is rejected on this MOM instance even with `loadlibrary("stats")` loaded. Use `normalcdf($z)` where `$z = (c - mu) / se`.

IMathAS text interpolation does NOT resolve `$arr[$varIndex]` in QT or Detailed Solution; precompute scalars like `$dirtext_picked = $dirtext[$dir]` in CC and reference the scalar. Slots 13 and 14 were patched accordingly.

The `mom-transfer` helper's `addToAssignment` uses description-based search; when a same-name question pre-exists in the MOM library it can pick that pre-existing qid instead of the freshly-created one. Slot 22 ended up bound to the older library copy 1777562 (which renders cleanly), and the freshly-created 1825510 is an orphan.

Question-type selector on `moddataset.php` is keyed by the `data-sn` attribute on `<a>` elements: multipart, multans, choices, essay, conditional. The earlier `createAndSave` helper that hard-coded Multipart misclassified slots 6, 10, 16, 18.
